title: Source-Bound Evidence for Restricted Reference-ET Potential Transpiration

driver_order.consequence: potential transpiration is a current meteorology/ET result prepared immediately before root uptake, not committed crop state

SWETR_1_configuration.crop_factor_requirement: SWETR=1 rejects SWCF=2, so crop factor CF is part of this route

no_interception_reduction.wet_fraction: ETpot resets wfrac to zero and ProcessMeteoDT does not replace it for SWINTER=0

weather_fixture_evidence: andelst_meteo.998 header: ETref column unit = mm
unit_reconciliation.execution_evidence: ETpot describes et0/ew0/es0 as mm/d and multiplies et0 by 0.1 when constructing ptra_dry
unit_reconciliation.conflicting_code_comment: MOD_meteo.f90 declaration comment for etr says cm d-1
unit_reconciliation.resolution_for_F_WOF18: Treat selected SWETR=1 ETref forcing as mm/day and the 0.1 factor as the source-bound mm-to-cm conversion. Do not propagate the conflicting global comment into the SWAP5 API.

ownership.crop_factor: read-only current crop factor view/derived crop quantity

important_nonclaims: This evidence does not qualify Penman-Monteith.
This evidence does not qualify interception modes SWINTER=1,2,3.
This evidence does not migrate weather-file I/O or daily-record selection.
This evidence does not qualify crop-factor, vegetation-cover or CO2-factor production by a complete crop host.
This evidence does not make a day the numerical timestep; it source-binds a rate-forming route whose legacy forcing record is daily.
